method: Parse original embedded Playwright Result JSON and SHA256 each artifact. Never use file modification time or tool-call elapsed duration as gameplay evidence.

Merge real timestamp envelopes across browsers before reporting wall time. Exact controller wait floors exclude delivery idle loops and free-roam final7s no-input observation. Warmup control time is included once and flagged; it is never added again to benchmark time.
No bundle is invented for artifacts that did not capture one. Adjacent manifests label historical series only. Multiple source revisions are not one final-build endurance run.
Android broad compatibility windows are envelopes, not fully timed active gameplay; explicit8s native handover is the only quantitatively credited Android interval here.
Failed visible-control ORR/bus approaches count as bounded maneuver test effort, while their requested interaction verdict remains failed/unproven; guard-only failures count zero.
